unsupported.claim: PTC thermal trip, hold, and reset
unsupported.reason: F1 is only its documented cold/hot resistance bounds

unsupported.claim: temperature-dependent SS34 reverse leakage
unsupported.reason: the low-order diode model is not selected-vendor leakage evidence

unsupported.claim: pulse beyond the published protection envelope
unsupported.reason: 36 V exceeds the selected F1 24 V maximum

unsupported.claim: real treadmill surge spectrum
unsupported.reason: actual source resistance, pulse waveform, and repetition require capture and bench work

unsupported.claim: R33 undervoltage hysteresis
unsupported.reason: the UV corners are divider-only; the R33 feedback from TREAD_OK (about 0.45 V of VIN-referred hysteresis, calculated) is not in this deck

unsupported.claim: physical brownout and real treadmill rail timing
unsupported.reason: relative VIN/+3V3 ramps are declared sources, not captures

unsupported.claim: TPS70950 current limit or thermal behavior
unsupported.reason: U5 is an enabled Thevenin source

unsupported.claim: logic propagation and partial-power leakage maxima
unsupported.reason: the gates are behavioral truth-table primitives

unsupported.claim: Q3 pump circuit behavior inside this deck
unsupported.reason: PULSE_ALIVE is a behavioral boolean here; the charge-pump circuit and its timing are modeled only in relay_drive_release

unsupported.claim: RF coupling into safety gates
unsupported.reason: RF behavior is outside a lumped static truth table

unsupported.claim: relay contact motion, release, bounce, or continuity
unsupported.reason: coil current decay is not contact motion evidence

unsupported.claim: guaranteed relay inductance
unsupported.reason: 0.1/0.5/1 H are documented engineering sweeps, not Omron limits

unsupported.claim: BC817 transient switching and combined-temperature saturation
unsupported.reason: no selected-vendor transistor macromodel establishes these behaviors

unsupported.claim: measured Q3 liveness pickup and release timing
unsupported.reason: the charge pump is simulated with low-order Schottky, smooth-conductance MOSFET, and ideal-capacitor approximations; gate threshold, capacitor tolerance and leakage, and relay contact response need bench measurement

unsupported.claim: firmware RELAY_PULSE generation
unsupported.reason: the 1 kHz square wave is an ideal source; the real-pin IO8 edge timing under load, the esp_timer task, and the firmware watchdog coupling are unproven on hardware

unsupported.claim: how long a flash operation really stalls the tasks
unsupported.reason: 45, 100 and 400 ms are assumed durations (typical and datasheet-worst sector erase); the flash chip in the module and its real erase times are unmeasured

unsupported.claim: real esp_timer and safety-loop timing on the chip
unsupported.reason: tick and loop times are chosen by the trace generator, not measured; jitter under Wi-Fi, BLE and flash load is unproven on hardware

unsupported.claim: measured Q3 pickup and release timing, and relay contact motion
unsupported.reason: same low-order pump, Q3 and coil models as relay_drive_release; coil current is not contact motion

unsupported.claim: real cable loop inductance and resistance
unsupported.reason: 0.5/2/5 uH and 0.1/0.5 ohm are assumed corners, not measured on any RJ45 patch cable

unsupported.claim: contact bounce, arcing and insertion speed during hot-plug
unsupported.reason: the plug-in is one ideal 2 us voltage step; real insertion can chatter and re-strike

unsupported.claim: treadmill source impedance, source-side capacitance and actual 8-9 V range
unsupported.reason: 8 V is nominal and 9 V is an assumed upper bound; the source is ideal behind Rs

unsupported.claim: ceramic capacitance loss at the ring peak and capacitor ESL
unsupported.reason: capacitance is a fixed 22/26/43.2 uF with 5 mohm ESR, not a voltage-dependent model

unsupported.claim: PTC F1 thermal trip, hold and reset
unsupported.reason: F1 is fixed at its 0.11 ohm cold resistance

unsupported.claim: repetitive hot-plug events and part lifetime
unsupported.reason: one plug-in event per branch; no cumulative stress or damage threshold is modeled

unsupported.claim: interaction with U2 buck start-up and load damping
unsupported.reason: the load is a 10 kohm resistor; U2 starts after the ring and is not modeled

unsupported.claim: relay contact motion, release, bounce or continuity
unsupported.reason: coil current is the only output; below 2 mA and above 14.7 mA are current thresholds, not contact evidence

unsupported.claim: measured or vendor-model behavior of TPS54202, TPS3700, TPS70950, SN74LVC2G08 or BC817
unsupported.reason: the buck is an averaged source with an assumed UVLO, U4 is thresholds plus RC delays, U5 is an ideal source with an assumed dropout, U6 is a truth table with a rail dependence, Q1 is a generic Gummel-Poon device

unsupported.claim: fail-safe behavior after a brownout
unsupported.reason: the coil re-energizes by itself when VIN returns and the MCU pins stay asserted; whether firmware latches TREAD_OK loss is not simulated

unsupported.claim: ESP32 boot, reset or brownout-detector behavior
unsupported.reason: pins are ideal logic levels scaled by modelled +3V3 and re-assert instantly when it returns; no MCU, GPIO threshold or leakage corner is modelled

unsupported.claim: a 1 ms dip at nominal 26 uF VIN capacitance
unsupported.reason: VIN falls to within a few tens of millivolts of the undervoltage trip point; the outcome changed with solver step, so only the 22 uF copy is asserted

unsupported.claim: exact chatter counts without R33
unsupported.reason: counts are integrals of short TREAD_OK pulses and resolve to about one count; the limits are regression brackets

unsupported.claim: UV trip levels quoted in NETLIST.md (6.31 V falling, 6.85 V rising)
unsupported.reason: this model derives about 5.91 V falling and 6.4 V rising from the netlist resistor values; the document figures are not reproduced and are not asserted

unsupported.claim: component tolerance, temperature and VIN-capacitance corners
unsupported.reason: one nominal corner plus a 22 uF copy, Q3 threshold corners in s7 and a narrow comparator band in s3c only

unsupported.claim: requirement A FAILS at cold: coil fully on
unsupported.reason: at -20 C with VDD=3.0 V, a pin that reaches 2.6 V/0.4 V, weak-end C22/C23/R34/R35/f/duty and a Vf-high diode, the steady gate is 1.446 V, below the 1.585 V highest cold threshold: the model coil current is 5 nA. With a rail-to-rail 3.0 V pin the gate is 2.129 V (0.544 V margin, passes)

unsupported.claim: requirement A (0.5 V above the highest threshold) FAILS at 25 C and 70 C with the weak driver
unsupported.reason: margins are 0.19 V (25 C), 0.38 V (70 C), 0.29 V (70 C, maximum diode leakage); the model coil still carries 21 mA because ESP_Q3 conducts fully the moment the gate passes VT, which a real AO3400A does not

unsupported.claim: requirement B FAILS: pickup within 15 ms and within the firmware 30 ms precharge
unsupported.reason: weak-pump pickup to the highest threshold is 34.9 ms at 25 C (gate 1.378 V at 30 ms against 1.45 V), 24.4 ms at 70 C, 27.5 ms at 70 C with maximum diode leakage, and never at -20 C

unsupported.claim: requirement C: release inside the 0.2 s test bound
unsupported.reason: strong pump, 126.5 nF C22, 1.265 uF C23, 101 kohm R34, 0.515 V threshold: 184 ms held low, 204 ms held high, and 221/244 ms if the diode leakage is only the 25 C typical; add the firmware 20 ms for 204 to 264 ms from MCU hang to coil off. Only the held-low figure with 70 C typical leakage is under 0.2 s

unsupported.claim: requirement D FAILS: single stray edge at least 0.1 V under the lowest threshold
unsupported.reason: the strongest pump gives 0.508 V from one edge, 7 mV under the 0.515 V hot lowest threshold; three consecutive 1.05 kHz edges give 0.917 V and cross it, and a pin toggling every 10 ms reaches 1.51 V, above even the 1.45 V 25 C highest threshold

unsupported.claim: corner values as measured behavior
unsupported.reason: capacitor derating, the Q3 temperature coefficient and the Vf and leakage points read from the Diodes Incorporated BAT54 data sheet are assumptions; the Nexperia data sheet was unreachable and the Samsung capacitor curves were not obtained

unsupported.claim: relay contact motion, release, bounce, or continuity
unsupported.reason: coil current decay is not contact motion evidence

unsupported.claim: native USB pull-up and attach behavior
unsupported.reason: this is a firmware and bench gate, not a Q2 simulation result
